articles.title: 5 SEO Tasks You Can Automate with ChatGPT
articles.excerpt: You have a crawl report full of warnings, a few pages losing clicks, and a backlog that already needs attention. ChatGPT can help turn that information into work you can actually finish: a prioritized…
articles.body: You have a crawl report full of warnings, a few pages losing clicks, and a backlog that already needs attention. ChatGPT can help turn that information into work you can actually finish: a prioritized fix list, a focused investigation, or a batch of metadata drafts. The useful part of ChatGPT for SEO is giving it real evidence to work with. Asking it to “audit my website” without crawl results or access to your search data leaves too much room for guesses. You can supply exports and page content yourself. A connected SEO tool makes the process more repeatable by letting ChatGPT retrieve the data during the conversation. MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is one way to provide that connection. These five tasks automate the repetitive retrieval, sorting, and drafting.
articles.author: Mustafa Aydemir

articles.title: I used AI to cheat my way to a 156-day reading streak
articles.excerpt: I asked Codex to recover my Apple Books reading streak. Very important engineering work, obviously. Books showed two days. I had an 80-day run in the history, then a gap, then a few scattered reading…
articles.body: I asked Codex to recover my Apple Books reading streak. Very important engineering work, obviously. Books showed two days. I had an 80-day run in the history, then a gap, then a few scattered reading days. It happens to the best of us. The app was reporting exactly what it had recorded. I wanted the old streak back anyway, so I asked an agent to fill the gap. It ended up showing 156 days and New Record . I have read so much. Before we go any further: don't try this at home. This is cheating. Do actual reading. The agent added reading time to dates that were below the goal. Those entries were manufactured. Nobody read 71 extra days while a script was running. But the process was interesting. It involved private Swift APIs, backups, a background process, and, of course, a cache.

articles.title: Bill C-8 and the CCSPA: What Integrators Need to Know
articles.excerpt: Bill C-8 received Royal Assent on 15 June 2026. It is now Statutes of Canada 2026, chapter 9. If you have been tracking this as Bill C-26, that bill died at the 2025 prorogation and came back under a…
articles.body: Bill C-8 received Royal Assent on 15 June 2026. It is now Statutes of Canada 2026, chapter 9. If you have been tracking this as Bill C-26, that bill died at the 2025 prorogation and came back under a new number. Same architecture, new label. Most of the coverage since June has been written for boardrooms. This is the version for the people who actually install and maintain the systems, because the supply chain clauses reach further down than the headlines suggest. Two parts, and only one of them is live The single most useful thing to understand about C-8 is that it did two different things on two different timelines. Part 1 amends the Telecommunications Act. It is in force now.

articles.title: I Built an AI That Checks Whether Digital Products Deliver What They Promise
articles.excerpt: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 2: Side Hustle. A digital-product listing can promise “48 pages”, “A4 and US Letter editions”, and “debt repayment worksheets.”…
articles.body: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 2: Side Hustle . I Built an AI That Checks Whether Digital Products Deliver What They Promise A digital-product listing can promise “48 pages”, “A4 and US Letter editions”, and “debt repayment worksheets.” Then the customer opens the ZIP and finds something else. For a small seller, that turns into refunds, support messages, rough reviews, and the awful feeling that you missed something obvious. PromiseDiff is a local-first pre-publish check for Etsy, Gumroad, template, and educational-PDF sellers. Paste in the listing. Upload the actual PDF or ZIP. PromiseDiff shows what the files can back up, what they contradict, and what they simply cannot prove. The rule I cared about most: missing text is not a failure.

articles.title: I Built FixMyCSV to Turn Messy Retail Data into Trustworthy Data with AI
articles.excerpt: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 2: Side Hustle FixMyCSV is a command-line data cleaning assistant designed for small retail businesses that manage inventory an…
articles.body: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 2: Side Hustle What I Built FixMyCSV is a command-line data cleaning assistant designed for small retail businesses that manage inventory and other business data in CSV files. It helps users identify data quality issues such as missing values, inconsistent formatting, duplicate records, and negative numeric values. It uses Google Gemma to suggest possible cleaning actions and allows users to preview and approve supported changes before saving a cleaned copy. FixMyCSV also supports storing business-specific cleaning rules through Backboard and maintaining a history of cleaning operations using SQLite.

articles.title: Why Businesses Should Reassess Content Gating for AI Search Visibility
articles.excerpt: A form can be valuable when it helps a business identify genuinely interested prospects. It can also create a trade-off: when the useful substance of a report sits entirely behind a gate, fewer people…
articles.body: A form can be valuable when it helps a business identify genuinely interested prospects. It can also create a trade-off: when the useful substance of a report sits entirely behind a gate, fewer people can evaluate, share, and discover that information before submitting their details. As AI-powered search becomes another route through which people find answers, businesses should reassess whether every high-value resource needs to be fully gated. The central question is not whether forms are good or bad. It is whether a particular asset is being asked to do two different jobs at once: attract broad attention and capture lead details. Those objectives can conflict when the information that would establish relevance is unavailable until after a visitor converts.

articles.body: NEW YORK — Set your phasers to back-to-school, space fans. Star Trek is going back to Starfleet Academy for season 2, and we finally have a release date. articles.body: Nostalgia is a hell of a thing, especially when it comes to sci-fi. For "Star Trek" fans wanting to mark the franchise's 60th anniversary this year, a geeky pilgrimage to upstate New York should be on the cards. Why? Because alongside the splendid autumnal colors, they can steer over to Ticonderoga to behold the newly installed Galileo shuttlecraft. After a complete two-year restoration project in 2012 headed up by superfan and collector Adam Schneider, this iconic fictional spacecraft, seen by millions in seven episodes over three seasons of "Star Trek: The Original Series," was recently relocated from its former home at the Johnson Space Center Museum in Houston, Texas.

articles.title: Earth's poles shifted surprisingly fast during the age of dinosaurs, ancient sea levels reveal
articles.excerpt: The location of Earth's geographic poles has changed several times over the past 320 million years in a process known as true polar wander.
articles.body: The location of Earth's geographic poles has changed several times over the past 320 million years in a process known as true polar wander, according to measurements of ancient flooding brought about by sea level changes resulting from our planet's crust shifting relative to Earth's spin axis. Such a shift can affect climate, both on local scales and globally, as regions that were by the poles find themselves moving down to lower latitudes and vice versa. This can then affect atmospheric circulation patterns, which affect climate across the world. The changes would have affected the environments in which life developed and evolved, from the age of the dinosaurs through to some of our oldest primate ancestors.

articles.title: How to watch 'VisionQuest' online — stream the MCU's 'WandaVision' spinoff series from anywhere
articles.excerpt: How to watch "VisionQuest", the MCU spinoff starring Paul Bettany, James Spader and Todd Stashwick. Cheapest options, where to watch in US, UK, Canada, Australia and beyond.
articles.body: Vision (Paul Bettany) is laying low, working the pumps at an Edinburgh pub at the outset of new eight-part Marvel Television entry "VisionQuest", and understandably so given how much the synthezoid has been through. Resurrected and restored after being sacrificed for the greater good in "Avengers: Infinity War", albeit as an ever-more-disconnected version of what came before, he now spends every other waking hour retreating into a big white house deep within his mindspace, to chew the fat with AI agents J.A.R.V.I.S. (Brian D’Arcy), F.R.I.D.A.Y. (Orla Brady), D.U.M-E (Henry Lewis), U (Jonathan Sayer) and E.D.I.T.H. (Emily Hampshire), and a wisecracking Ultron (James Spader).
